original_value: The ASUS GeForce GT 1030 Phoenix OC edition features a dual-ball bearing fan for superior airflow and 2X lifespan over reference. Auto-extreme manufacturing technology with Super Alloy Power II delivers premium quality and reliability. GPU Tweak II enables additional control to ensure an optimal balance between performance, cooling and noise.
